why: Comparing every length-m window of sequence with pattern is the sliding window, but with lengths up to 2*10^5 a direct compare per window is O(n*m). KMP (or a rolling hash) slides the window in linear time.
hints: Every candidate is a window of length len(pattern); naive comparison of each window can be quadratic, for example on 'aaaa...a'.
Use KMP: precompute for the pattern the longest proper prefix that is also a suffix, so after a mismatch or a full match you never re-read text characters.
Build the failure table in O(m), scan the text in O(n), and on a full match record i - m + 1 and fall back via the table so overlapping matches are found.
pitfalls: Pattern longer than sequence, or an empty sequence: return [].
Indices are zero-based starts, in ascending order.
